description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth.
We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to design and maintain scalable, resilient infrastructure supporting high-volume data processing and alerting. This role combines Kubernetes administration, AWS infrastructure engineering, automation, and observability to ensure reliable operations across distributed systems.
You will collaborate with development teams to streamline deployments, optimize infrastructure performance, and troubleshoot complex issues.
Required Clearance Level: Active TS/SCI with Polygraph

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure supporting distributed applications and data alerting systems.



 
 Orchestrate containerized workloads using Kubernetes and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS).



 
 Configure, maintain, and optimize AWS infrastructure, including EC2 and S3.



 
 Develop and maintain Terraform configurations to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration.



 
 Design and troubleshoot routing and DNS configurations to support availability and performance.



 
 Deploy and support RabbitMQ and Kafka for reliable messaging and large-scale data streaming.



 
 Implement monitoring and visualization using Grafana.



 
 Maintain logging and alerting capabilities to identify operational issues and support proactive incident response.



 
 Collaborate with development teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and apply DevOps practices.



 
 Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, messaging, and application deployment issues.



 
 Apply cloud security and automation best practices to strengthen reliability and operational efficiency.



 
 Improve infrastructure scalability, resilience, performance, and cost efficiency.






Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 


 

 
 Hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes environments.



 
 Experience with AWS services, including EKS, EC2, and S3.



 
 Experience using Terraform for infrastructure as code.



 
 Experience configuring and supporting RabbitMQ and Kafka.



 
 Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD workflows.



 
 Experience configuring and troubleshooting routing and DNS.



 
 Experience using Grafana for infrastructure monitoring and visualization.



 
 Experience implementing and maintaining logging and alerting capabilities.



 
 Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across distributed infrastructure and services.



 
 Knowledge of cloud security and infrastructure automation best practices.



 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with development and operations teams.






Preferred Qualifications
 

 
 Experience supporting scalable applications on Kubernetes.



 
 Experience handling high-volume data alerts.



 
 Experience working on large projects in complex, fast-paced environments.




 #CJ



Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
